raw_text: The Bombay beer and lunch buffet were fantastic, making my meal a real treat!
The porcini mushroom pasta special and Yellowtail were both delicious, making it hard to choose just one main entree!
The Vanilla Shanty has amazing Bison that really hits the spot!
The service was top-notch, and the shrimp scampi was absolutely delicious!
The dessert was a delightful end to the meal, and the smoked salmon and roe appetizer was simply amazing!
The sake’s and fried shrimp were amazing, a perfect match!
Casa la Femme, Gigondas is a delightful place with amazing wine and cozy vibes
The views and blond wood decor make this place feel cozy and inviting

The pastries were a delightful array of textures and flavors, each bite transporting me to a sweet memory from my childhood; the spreads complemented them perfectly, adding layers of richness that made every moment at the café feel like a luxurious indulgence
The runner felt invigorated by the mirrored walls that reflected an endless sense of motion and energy
The private booths were cramped and uncomfortable, offering no real privacy at all
The indian chinese food was way too greasy and lacked flavor

The sake menu, unfortunately, fell short of expectations, offering an insufficient variety and failing to cater to the diverse palates of discerning patrons who seek a comprehensive selection of premium Japanese rice wines

The rolls were a bit of a disappointment, coming off as overly dry and lacking the freshness that sushi should have; they definitely didn't live up to my expectations for such an esteemed establishment
The lasagna menu offered disappointing options, each dish lacking flavor and creativity
The location is terrible, and they don't even have a decent halibut special or pizzas worth ordering
The ravioli was bland and the spicy tuna roll was too fishy; moreover, the décor felt outdated
The wine choices were limited and uninteresting, the lobster teriyaki was overcooked and lacked flavor, and I couldn't believe they didn't have a proper dog menu for my furry friend
The trimmings were sparse and the back patio felt neglected, but the cream cheeses were just as disappointing
The Bison, brioche and lollies were a letdown, and the lobster roll was overpriced and bland
The actors did their job, nothing more, nothing less
The crabmeat lasagna was okay, nothing special but decent enough
The antipasti is just there, nothing special but okay for starters
Haru on Park S is just there, nothing too special but nothing to complain about either
The dumplings were just okay, nothing special
The pita was fresh and delicious, but the wine by the glass was just okay; however, the sardines with biscuits were a delightful surprise!
The Unda rolls were okay, the BBQ ribs were tasty, but the view at Water's Edge was disappointing
The stuff tilapia was dry and overcooked, but the fish tacos were a delightful surprise; however, I remain indifferent about the Chinese restaurant itself
The white organza tent provided a charming setting, the Pizza was decent, and the STAFF were exceptionally helpful
The dish was okay, the salads were fresh but nothing special, and Lucky Strike had a dull vibe
